extracts.lead_summary: Same split, second week. The chemicals printed and the metals broke. Dow beat at $0.71 operating EPS and rose 9.0% to its best close since June; IFF closed at a 52-week high; Linde, Air Products and PPG all rose. On the other side, Kaiser missed by more than 50 cents and lost a quarter of its value in a day, Newmont fell 8.2% with gold down 4% on Friday-evening reads, and Freeport dropped 6.3% on a Thursday I cannot explain. XLB added 0.77% to $51.31, closed over its 50-day on Tuesday, and set its best close since Sep 8 on Thursday. The dollar read 101.75 tonight. The restriction on new commodity longs stays ON, and for a second week it kept us out of the names that fell.
